Additionally, the arrangement of the croissants defies gravity slightly, appearing to lean without clear support, and the depth layering in the background cluster is somewhat ambiguous. Despite these issues, the overall composition is coherent and visually plausible as a still life, preventing a catastrophic authenticity score.
